_comment: overflow:hidden (+ border-radius) clipping TRANSFORMED content. Spec: the overflow clip is applied in the CLIPPER's coordinate space to descendants' final painted geometry — i.e. AFTER their transforms (css-overflow-3 §3 with css-transforms-1 §6: a transformed descendant is painted, then the ancestor's clip applies); and an element's own transform maps its already-clipped content into the parent space (clip INSIDE the transform, css-transforms-1 §6). ARITHMETIC — ROT_SquareClip_TranslatedChild: parent 120x80 #f1c40f=(241,196,15), child 100x72 at (10,4) translated +40x -> occupies x[50,150], clipped by parent x<=120 -> visible red 70x72 (5040 px red vs 9600-5040=4560 px yellow ring, red dominant). If the clip were wrongly applied PRE-transform, the pre-clipped child translates out whole -> red bbox [100,72] painting past the parent. ROT_RadiusClip_TranslatedChild: parent 120x80 radius 24, child fills the parent (120x80 at 0,0) translated +30x -> red = translated rect INTERSECT rounded-rect: leftmost x=30 (>r=24 so full height there), rightmost x=120 at the middle rows -> bbox [90,80]; red area ~ roundedRect(9106) - leftStrip(2153) = 6953 > yellow 2153, red dominant. Pre-transform clip instead rounds the child FIRST and translates the rounded shape out whole -> bbox [120,80]. ROT_RadiusClip_NoTransform control: both clip models agree -> red fills the rounded rect, bbox [120,80]. ROT_SelfRotate_ClippedChild: parent 80x60 overflow hidden rotate(45deg), oversized child (120x100 at (-20,-20)) covers it entirely -> correct = clip child to the 80x60 box THEN rotate the whole element: red diamond bbox (80+60)*cos45 = 98.99 -> [99,99]. Clip OUTSIDE the transform (the iOS audit-backlog bug: 'clipped by its un-transformed axis-aligned frame') leaves an axis-aligned 80x60 red rect -> [80,60]. ROT_SelfRotate_ClippedChild WAS red on iOS (clip outside the transform, [80,60]) until wave 50 lane B8 chained .engineVisibility inner of .engineTransforms in StyleBuilder.applyStyle; its iOS waiver was deleted the same wave (a stale waiver is exit 5 on the gate set) and the wave-50 gate is its first on-device measurement. The two translated-child rows exercise the parent-clips-child path and may also be red on iOS — possible, not predicted. GEOMETRY NOTE: the uniform margin keeps transform-escaped paint inside the overflow:hidden 390x(layout+32) capture canvas (CaptureGallery.tsx canvasStyle) — without it a CORRECT renderer clips at the canvas edge and the box expectation reads false-red on every platform. Do not 'simplify' the margin away.

_expect.note: clip post-transform: child x[50,150] cut at parent edge 120 -> 70 wide; pre-transform bug reads [100,72]
rounded clip post-transform: red x[30,120] (arc apex at mid rows), full height at x in [24,96] -> [90,80]; pre-transform bug carries the rounded shape out -> [120,80]
control — no transform, both clip models agree: red fills the rounded rect, bbox = parent box

css-transforms-1 §6: clip inside the transform — 80x60 clipped content rotates to a (80+60)*cos45=98.99 diamond. WAS RED on iOS until wave 50: clip outside the transform read [80,60], repaired by lane B8 (BACKLOG queue 6(d)) chaining .engineVisibility INNER of .engineTransforms in StyleBuilder.applyStyle, so the waiver this note carried is deleted. MEASUREMENT NOTE: box is the bbox of fill-band pixels, and a rotated diamond's tips are heavily antialiased, so the strict-colour bbox under-reads the geometric extent by up to ~5px (worst under scaleX(2): web itself measures 108x54 against the geometric 113x57). boxTolerance 6 absorbs that while keeping the bug renders (deltas 25-31px) unmistakable.
